objective: sum over foods and suppliers of purchase price * purchase + sum over foods and links of transport_cost * flow; the purchase price is the supplier's local price for the food, or the food's international price when local_prices has no row for the pair

supplier.description: City where food can be bought
supplier.label: supplier

country.description: Country of the supplier city (informational; not used by the model)
country.label: country

supplier_type.description: Supplier type code from the source data (informational; not used by the model): I for the three suppliers outside Syria (Amman, Beirut, Gaziantep), R and L for Syrian cities, L marking the three that also host a camp
supplier_type.label: supplier type code

country.description: Country of the camp (informational; not used by the model)
country.label: country

beneficiaries.description: Number of people the camp feeds every day
beneficiaries.label: number of beneficiaries

from_city.description: City the directed road link starts from (a supplier, a camp or a city food only passes through)
from_city.label: origin city

to_city.description: City the directed road link leads to
to_city.label: destination city

transport_cost.description: Cost of shipping one unit (100 g) of any food along the link. The three links from a city to itself (Daraa, Dayr_Az_Zor, Hassakeh) cost 0 and carry nothing useful: they net out of the city's balance
transport_cost.label: transport cost per unit

food.description: Food commodity that can go into a ration
food.label: food

international_price.description: Price of the food at every supplier that has no local price for it (all foods at Amman, Beirut and Gaziantep)
international_price.label: international price

nutrient.description: Nutrient, with its unit in parentheses (NicacinB3 is niacin, spelled as in the source)
nutrient.label: nutrient

min_per_person.unit: nutrient unit per person per day
min_per_person.description: Minimum daily intake of the nutrient per person; intake may not exceed max_nutrient_factor times this value
min_per_person.label: minimum daily intake per person

amount.description: Amount of the nutrient in 100 g of the food; a missing (food, nutrient) row counts as 0
amount.label: nutrient content per 100 g

price.description: Mean of the monthly procurement prices from January 2017 to October 2021 for the food at this supplier; without a row the supplier sells the food at its international price
price.label: local price

max_nutrient_factor.description: Upper limit on each nutrient's daily intake per person, as a multiple of its minimum requirement
max_nutrient_factor.label: nutrient upper limit as a multiple of the minimum

max_purchase.description: Most units of one food that can be bought at one supplier; deliberately large in the original, so it never binds
max_purchase.label: purchase limit per food and supplier

decision_variables.ration[food, camp]: units (100 g) of the food each person in the camp receives per day (>= 0)
decision_variables.purchase[food, supplier]: units of the food bought at the supplier per day (0..max_purchase; fixed to 0 when the food has neither a local nor an international price)
decision_variables.flow[food, from_city, to_city]: units of the food shipped along the link per day (>= 0); the flows on links from a city to itself are inert and not part of the flow measure
decision_variables.nutrient_surplus[nutrient, camp]: daily intake per person above the minimum (0..(max_nutrient_factor - 1) * min_per_person): the range variable of the original's ranged nutrition row; not a measure

constraints.nutrition[nutrient, camp]: sum over foods of amount * ration - nutrient_surplus = min_per_person, i.e. min_per_person <= intake per person <= max_nutrient_factor * min_per_person
constraints.balance[food, city]: inflow - outflow = beneficiaries * ration (if the city is a camp) - purchase (if the city is a supplier), for every city that is a supplier, a camp or the end of a link

ration.label: ration per person (units of 100 g a day)

purchase.label: food bought (units of 100 g a day)

flow.label: food shipped (units of 100 g a day)
